name: M7 105 mm howitzer motor carriage
about: Made by tools/battle-models (tank). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 upper, 1 upper2, 2 shade, 3 track, 4 rubber, 5 steel, 6 bright, 7 wood, 8 canvas, 9 glass, 10 black, 11 rust, 12 lamp, 13 white, 14 red, 15 yellow, 16 blue, 17 leather, 18 torn, 19 rope, 20 cloth, 21 skin, 22 brass, 23 canvas.seat, 24 canvas.net, 25 canvas.tarp, 26 zinc, 27 zinc.in `mid`: the middle mesh, for about 40 to 140 m (~15,000 triangles): the near mesh thinned, small pieces gone, the far mesh's track band in place of the links, alike parts (road wheels) carrying the same mesh; its `part` numbers count the parts without the track links, as `far`'s do.

tracks.left.about: the left track runs on by one link (152 mm): loop it at (that side's speed in m/s) / stride * long; backward to go astern

tracks.right.about: the right track runs on by one link (152 mm): loop it at (that side's speed in m/s) / stride * long; backward to go astern

start.about: the engine is started: she shudders, a gout of smoke from the exhaust

drive.about: under way: the hull's own motion (the game rolls the wheels, runs the tracks and moves her)

move_off.about: she moves off: the nose lifts as the tracks bite, and settles

stop.about: she brakes: start it as the brakes go on. The nose dips and stays down while she slows; she is at rest `rest` seconds in (play it faster or slower to fit), and the nose comes back up, a little over, and settles

fire.about: the main gun fires: flash and blast at 0.0, the barrel runs back at once and out again over a second, the empty case a moment after

fire.rock.about: the hull's answer to the shot, for a gun trained ahead: she is thrown back on her springs, the nose lifts about a degree, and she settles in a second. With the turret trained off, turn this about the turret's bearing or play it weaker

mg_burst.about: a burst from the machine gun beside the main gun: ten rounds

open_up.about: the commander's hatch is opened (she travels opened up; play it backward to close down for action)

knocked_out.about: knocked out: struck at 0.0, hatches thrown open as the crew bail out, the gun droops, smoke, then fire at the engine; holds its last pose (follow with `burn`)

burn.about: burning: fire at the engine and out of her hatches, black smoke (loop after knocked_out or brew_up)

turret.what: trained by the game: + to the right (clockwise from above)

gun.what: laid by the game inside its limits: + muzzle up

name_place.how: Once her unit has come through three battles the game paints her crew's mark here. kind `name`: an invented name (four to ten letters to a line) in brush-painted capitals, never a printed face: the middle of it at `at` on the plate that looks along `facing`, the writing running along `along` with its top toward `up`, the letters `high` tall and the whole no longer than that place's `long`; it rides `part`, and a place is given for each side that carries one. A name too long for one line at `high`: on two lines where the place has `lines` 2 and the name two words (letters `high_two` tall, or `high` where that is not given), else painted smaller, but never under `least`; a name that fits neither way is not for this tank. `writing` down: the characters stand one under another, `long` the room downward. `script` japanese: her name is in Japanese characters, and only the names in brush-alphabet.json `japanese.names` have theirs drawn; for any other name paint nothing (never Latin letters on her); a name of a single character is `high_one` tall. kind `rings`: no name, but `most` thin bands round the barrel, the first at `at` and each next one `step` on along `toward` (to the breech), `wide` across, lying on the barrel whose radius there is `radius`; one ring, then more as she lasts. `ink`: for a name off-white on grey, olive and green coats and near-black on dark yellow; rings off-white on every coat. Matt, never brighter than her national marking; it wears and scorches with her paint.
name_place.when: her unit has come through three battles

running.how: turn each wheel by (distance run on its side) / radius, in radians; play tracks.left and tracks.right at (speed of that side) / stride * long

units: the artillery that keeps up with the United States' armor (the Free French were lent her too)
